question: By whom is the deity served?
premises: great ṣoḍhā gives rise to all deity groups
deity is served by those groups
inference: The deity is served by all deity groups arisen from the great ṣoḍhā.
uncertainties: exact meaning of ṣoḍhā depends on ritual context
